backend/main.mo: Canister storing user profiles and photo memories with access control for viewing, adding, and listing data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping Valentine UI features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files for build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global theme variables and base styles including light/dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining metadata and mounting root for the SPA.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up React Query provider and renders the ValentinePage with a global toaster.
frontend/src/components/animation/Sectio: Wrapper applying fade‑in entrance animations with optional delay and reduced‑motion fallback.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Placeholder file intended for a login/logout button component using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Placeholder for a dialog prompting new users to set their display name.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationOverl: Animated confetti and sparkles overlay that displays acceptance messages after clicking Yes.
frontend/src/components/feedback/AccessR: Placeholder for a component that prompts users to log in before accessing protected features.
frontend/src/components/InitialBackgroun: Generates floating gradient particles for animated background unless reduced-motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/InitialFloatingH: Displays animated floating heart emojis with randomized timing unless motion is reduced.
Placeholder for the main layout shell including header, footer, and content container.
frontend/src/config/valentineConfig.ts: Provides static Valentine-themed UI text, images, and asset paths used across the landing page.
frontend/src/features/animations/Animati: Empty file placeholder for an animations page component.
frontend/src/features/games/GamesPage.ts: Empty file placeholder for a games page component.
frontend/src/features/games/gameStyles.c: Empty stylesheet placeholder for game-related styles.
frontend/src/features/games/StickerMemor: Empty file intended for a sticker-based memory match game component.
frontend/src/features/memories/MemoriesG: Empty file intended to display a gallery of memory items.
frontend/src/features/memories/MemoriesP: Empty page component placeholder for the Memories section.
frontend/src/features/memories/MemoryDet: Empty file for a dialog component showing memory details.
frontend/src/features/memories/MemoryUpl: Empty file for a component used to upload new memory items.
frontend/src/features/valentine/Valentin: Implements the interactive Valentine landing page with animations, evasive button behavior, and acceptance celebration.
frontend/src/features/warning/WarningPag: Deprecated warning page that gates access with an acknowledgment before showing placeholder content.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity authentication with automatic query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvasiveButton.ts: Handles logic for a button that moves away from the user, calculating safe positions and interaction handlers.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity integration, including login, logout, and stored identity management.
frontend/src/hooks/useMemories.ts: Empty hook placeholder for memory-related data operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Empty hook placeholder for managing user profile data.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styles including a full Valentine theme and page-specific styling.
frontend/src/lib/fileToExternalBlob.ts: Empty utility placeholder for converting files to external blobs.
frontend/src/lib/time.ts: Empty utility placeholder for time-related helpers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash-based), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them when needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, radii, shadows, plugins, and content paths.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, existing features, and image needs for the Valentine’s page build.
